name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.15: refuse a keyless build to a machine that has not migrated its key. A generic build carries no baked-in machine key, so a machine still depending on one would install it and immediately 401 into a hard-failed connection needing a site visit — and that is unrecoverable remotely. A release can now be published with requiresStoredKey true, and the app-update manifest withholds it from any machine whose last config_health did not report keySource stored, treating never-reported as not-migrated since a machine that was offline during the migration is exactly the one at risk. Per-machine builds are unaffected, so the migration rollout itself still reaches the existing fleet. The dashboard already warned about this; the manifest guard makes the mistake impossible rather than merely visible. Cumulative over v6.14.
